post.description: Authenticated by signature instead of a bearer token: GitHub `X-Hub-Signature-256` and Bitbucket `X-Hub-Signature` carry `sha256=<HMAC-SHA256 of the body>`; GitLab sends the secret in `X-GitLab-Token`. Push, pull/merge request and tag events start a focused run; other events return 202 with status `ignored`.
